diff --git a/Solidity/Hash/CollisionBound.lean b/Solidity/Hash/CollisionBound.lean
index b54c93a5b24340a19160c1fb378d057ccee60f84..092971eda8c7d6997276a92ba19b25b7ce05844e 100644
--- a/Solidity/Hash/CollisionBound.lean
+++ b/Solidity/Hash/CollisionBound.lean
@@ -350,7 +350,7 @@
   | cons a l ih =>
     simp only [List.countP_cons]
     cases p a <;> cases r a <;> simp only [Bool.or_self, Bool.or_true, Bool.or_false,
-      if_true] <;> omega
+      ite_true] <;> omega
 
 theorem countP_le_of_imp {γ : Type _} (l : List γ) {p r : γ → Bool}
     (h : ∀ a ∈ l, p a = true → r a = true) : l.countP p ≤ l.countP r := by
@@ -405,7 +405,7 @@
           (List.nodup_cons.mp hnd).1
     have hsplit : A.countP (fun a => (x :: t).contains a) =
         A.countP (fun a => (a == x) || t.contains a) := by
-      congr 1
+      simp only [List.contains_cons]
     rw [hsplit, List.length_cons]
     have hor : A.countP (fun a => (a == x) || t.contains a) ≤
         A.countP (fun a => a == x) + A.countP (fun a => t.contains a) :=
@@ -529,11 +529,11 @@
     | cons a t =>
       rw [List.nodup_cons] at hxs
       simp only [List.length_cons, Nat.add_right_cancel_iff] at hl
-      simp only [List.map_cons, oracleOf, if_pos]
+      simp only [List.map_cons, oracleOf, ite_eq_left]
       congr 1
       refine Eq.trans (List.map_congr_left fun y hy => ?_) (ih hxs.2 hl)
       have : y ≠ x := fun h => hxs.1 (h ▸ hy)
-      simp only [if_neg this]
+      simp only [ite_eq_right this]
 
 /-- The list without repetitions, keeping each element's last occurrence. -/
 def dedup : List α → List α
@@ -545,17 +545,17 @@
   | nil => simp only [dedup]
   | cons x xs ih =>
     by_cases hx : x ∈ xs
-    · simp only [dedup, if_pos hx, ih, List.mem_cons]
+    · simp only [dedup, ite_eq_left hx, ih, List.mem_cons]
       exact ⟨Or.inr, fun h => h.elim (fun e => e ▸ hx) id⟩
-    · simp only [dedup, if_neg hx, List.mem_cons, ih]
+    · simp only [dedup, ite_eq_right hx, List.mem_cons, ih]
 
 theorem nodup_dedup (xs : List α) : (dedup xs).Nodup := by
   induction xs with
   | nil => exact List.nodup_nil
   | cons x xs ih =>
     by_cases hx : x ∈ xs
-    · simp only [dedup, if_pos hx]; exact ih
-    · simp only [dedup, if_neg hx]
+    · simp only [dedup, ite_eq_left hx]; exact ih
+    · simp only [dedup, ite_eq_right hx]
       exact List.nodup_cons.mpr ⟨fun h => hx (mem_dedup.mp h), ih⟩
 
 theorem length_dedup_le (xs : List α) : (dedup xs).length ≤ xs.length := by
@@ -563,8 +563,8 @@
   | nil => exact Nat.le_refl 0
   | cons x xs ih =>
     by_cases hx : x ∈ xs
-    · simp only [dedup, if_pos hx, List.length_cons]; omega
-    · simp only [dedup, if_neg hx, List.length_cons]; omega
+    · simp only [dedup, ite_eq_left hx, List.length_cons]; omega
+    · simp only [dedup, ite_eq_right hx, List.length_cons]; omega
 
 /-- A run may hash the same preimage twice; the premise is that of its
 distinct preimages. -/
@@ -655,7 +655,8 @@
     apply countP_le_of_imp
     intro a ha hn
     have ha' : a < N := List.mem_range.mp ha
-    simp only [decide_eq_true_eq, Near] at hn
+    have hn' : Near N L a b := of_decide_eq_true hn
+    unfold Near at hn'
     simp only [Bool.or_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
     omega
   have h1 := countP_or_le (List.range N)
@@ -675,7 +676,8 @@
     apply countP_le_of_imp
     intro a ha hn
     have ha' : a < N := List.mem_range.mp ha
-    simp only [decide_eq_true_eq, Covers] at hn
+    have hn' : Covers N L a r := of_decide_eq_true hn
+    unfold Covers at hn'
     simp only [Bool.or_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
     omega
   have h1 := countP_or_le (List.range N) (fun a => decide (r + 1 - L ≤ a ∧ a < r + 1))
diff --git a/Solidity/Hash/Adaptive.lean b/Solidity/Hash/Adaptive.lean
index cb5d5a1c61f7350aa01d9d0c81c8f4403b19fab3..20087c3f9525d6773c008708678eb67876ab9e14 100644
--- a/Solidity/Hash/Adaptive.lean
+++ b/Solidity/Hash/Adaptive.lean
@@ -50,8 +50,8 @@
     | nil => rfl
     | cons a t =>
       by_cases h : x = y
-      · simp only [upd, if_pos h, List.length_cons]
-      · simp only [upd, if_neg h, List.length_cons, ih]
+      · simp only [upd, ite_eq_left h, List.length_cons]
+      · simp only [upd, ite_eq_right h, List.length_cons, ih]
 
 theorem mem_upd {dom : List α} {t : List Nat} {x : α} {b c : Nat}
     (h : c ∈ upd dom t x b) : c = b ∨ c ∈ t := by
@@ -62,11 +62,11 @@
     | nil => exact Or.inr h
     | cons a t =>
       by_cases hx : x = y
-      · simp only [upd, if_pos hx, List.mem_cons] at h
+      · simp only [upd, ite_eq_left hx, List.mem_cons] at h
         rcases h with e | e
         · exact Or.inl e
         · exact Or.inr (List.mem_cons_of_mem a e)
-      · simp only [upd, if_neg hx, List.mem_cons] at h
+      · simp only [upd, ite_eq_right hx, List.mem_cons] at h
         rcases h with e | e
         · exact Or.inr (e ▸ List.mem_cons_self ..)
         · rcases ih e with e' | e'
@@ -83,8 +83,8 @@
     | cons a t =>
       by_cases hx : x = z
       · have hyz : y ≠ z := hx ▸ hy
-        simp only [upd, if_pos hx, oracleOf, if_neg hyz]
-      · simp only [upd, if_neg hx, oracleOf, ih]
+        simp only [upd, ite_eq_left hx, oracleOf, ite_eq_right hyz]
+      · simp only [upd, ite_eq_right hx, oracleOf, ih]
 
 theorem oracleOf_upd_self {dom : List α} {t : List Nat} {x : α} {b : Nat} (hx : x ∈ dom)
     (hl : t.length = dom.length) : oracleOf dom (upd dom t x b) x = b := by
@@ -96,9 +96,9 @@
     | cons a t =>
       simp only [List.length_cons, Nat.add_right_cancel_iff] at hl
       by_cases h : x = z
-      · simp only [upd, if_pos h, oracleOf]
+      · simp only [upd, ite_eq_left h, oracleOf]
       · have hx' : x ∈ zs := (List.mem_cons.mp hx).resolve_left h
-        simp only [upd, if_neg h, oracleOf, ih hx' hl]
+        simp only [upd, ite_eq_right h, oracleOf, ih hx' hl]
 
 theorem oracleOf_mem {dom : List α} {t : List Nat} {x : α} (hx : x ∈ dom)
     (hl : t.length = dom.length) : oracleOf dom t x ∈ t := by
@@ -110,9 +110,9 @@
     | cons a t =>
       simp only [List.length_cons, Nat.add_right_cancel_iff] at hl
       by_cases h : x = z
-      · simp only [oracleOf, if_pos h]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..
+      · simp only [oracleOf, ite_eq_left h]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..
       · have hx' : x ∈ zs := (List.mem_cons.mp hx).resolve_left h
-        simp only [oracleOf, if_neg h]
+        simp only [oracleOf, ite_eq_right h]
         exact List.mem_cons_of_mem a (ih hx' hl)
 
 theorem upd_upd (dom : List α) (t : List Nat) (x : α) (b c : Nat) :
@@ -124,8 +124,8 @@
     | nil => rfl
     | cons a t =>
       by_cases h : x = z
-      · simp only [upd, if_pos h]
-      · simp only [upd, if_neg h, ih]
+      · simp only [upd, ite_eq_left h]
+      · simp only [upd, ite_eq_right h, ih]
 
 theorem upd_oracleOf (dom : List α) (t : List Nat) (x : α) :
     upd dom t x (oracleOf dom t x) = t := by
@@ -136,8 +136,8 @@
     | nil => rfl
     | cons a t =>
       by_cases h : x = z
-      · simp only [upd, oracleOf, if_pos h]
-      · simp only [upd, oracleOf, if_neg h, ih]
+      · simp only [upd, oracleOf, ite_eq_left h]
+      · simp only [upd, oracleOf, ite_eq_right h, ih]
 
 end Upd
 
@@ -497,8 +497,8 @@
     have h0 : (tuples N dom.length).countP (eagerCollides s dom 0) = 0 := by
       rw [List.countP_eq_zero]
       intro g _
-      simp only [eagerCollides, eagerQueries, decide_eq_true_eq, Classical.not_not]
-      exact CollisionFree.nil
+      simp only [eagerCollides, eagerQueries]
+      exact fun h => (of_decide_eq_true h) CollisionFree.nil
     rw [h0]; exact Nat.zero_le _
   | q + 1 => by
     have ih : 2 * N * (tuples N dom.length).countP (eagerCollides s dom q) ≤
@@ -582,8 +582,8 @@
     have h0 : (tuples N dom.length).countP (eagerRegionsFail s dom N L roots 0) = 0 := by
       rw [List.countP_eq_zero]
       intro g _
-      simp only [eagerRegionsFail, eagerQueries, decide_eq_true_eq, Classical.not_not]
-      exact RegionsDisjoint.nil
+      simp only [eagerRegionsFail, eagerQueries]
+      exact fun h => (of_decide_eq_true h) RegionsDisjoint.nil
     rw [h0]; exact Nat.zero_le _
   | q + 1 => by
     have ih : 2 * N * (tuples N dom.length).countP (eagerRegionsFail s dom N L roots q) ≤
